cases.note: Python's name regex is case-insensitive ((?i)). The Go port (imprint-core tools/imprint-dev/typesafe.go MaskDetail) matches this since imprint-core-CL-013a: the per-name regexp.MustCompile now carries an explicit (?i) prefix.

cases.text: Wohnort laut Formular: 12345 Musterstadt am Fluss
cases.note: Python's PLZ+Ort pattern accepts any '(am|an der|im) <Capitalized word>' suffix generically. Since imprint-core-CL-013a, Go's plzOrtRE generalizes the 'am'/'an der' suffix the same way (any capitalized word); 'im'/'ob der' stay a fixed list (im Breisgau, ob der Tauber) so 'PLZ ist 10115 Berlin im Brief.' still leaves 'im Brief' unmasked (typesafe_test.go TestMaskAddresses) - a narrower parity than Python's fully generic 'im' handling, intentional and covered by both test suites.
